Medical retirement with VA post-discharge causation dispute. DoD medically retired this veteran — VA claiming conditions are post-service directly contradicts DoD's own finding. Records-first appeal path required. Accredited attorney recommended, not standard VSO intake.
Chronic homelessness (6+ months or repeat episodes). HUD-VASH priority tier — immediate housing routing required alongside all other domains.
Active criminal case in progress. Veterans Treatment Court routing is time-sensitive — request VTC diversion at next court appearance. Benefits routing continues in parallel.
Three or more urgent domains active simultaneously. This case requires a human navigator to coordinate across tracks — no single automated path covers this. Human coordinator referral is priority.

Local VA facility flagged as the obstruction. Routing must go AROUND the facility — OIG, congressional caseworker, Vet Center, Community Care, and VAMC transfer are the parallel escalation paths. Do not route back through a facility the veteran has identified as a barrier.

division_results.result_summary: HUD-VASH — VA + HUD Housing Voucher Program (Priority Tier)
division_results.next_action: Call VA National Call Center for Homeless Veterans now: 1-877-4AID-VET (1-877-424-3838) — 24/7. Tell them you are a veteran, you are currently unhoused, and you have been homeless for 6+ months. Ask specifically for a HUD-VASH referral. No paperwork required to make this call.
next_actions: VA National Call Center for Homeless Veterans — 1-877-4AID-VET (1-877-424-3838) — 24/7. This line connects to VA coordinators who initiate HUD-VASH referrals. Call this first. It is the fastest path into the system.

HUD-VASH (HUD-VA Supportive Housing) — joint VA and HUD program providing Section 8 vouchers specifically for homeless veterans, paired with VA case management. This is the priority tier. Chronic homelessness is the highest priority classification. Contact initiates the referral — no advance paperwork required to call.

VA Healthcare for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) — outreach and case management program operating at most VA facilities. Can connect to shelter, transitional housing, and long-term housing support. Entry point: same call line as above.
immediate_contacts: VA National Call Center for Homeless Veterans — 1-877-4AID-VET (1-877-424-3838) (24/7)

division_results.result_summary: Veterans Treatment Court — Diversion Before Incarceration
division_results.next_action: Call VA National Call Center for Homeless Veterans: 1-877-4AID-VET (1-877-424-3838) — 24/7. Find your local Veterans Treatment Court at justiceforvets.org — request VTC diversion at your next court appearance. Do not appear without an attorney familiar with veteran cases.
next_actions: Veterans Treatment Court (VTC) — specialized courts that divert veteran criminal cases into treatment tracks rather than incarceration when service-connected conditions (PTSD, TBI, MST, substance use) are a factor. Over 500 courts nationally. Find your local VTC at justiceforvets.org — TIME SENSITIVE, request VTC diversion immediately.

VTC Court Advocates — DAV (1-800-741-4990), AMVETS, and American Legion have trained court advocates who accompany veterans to VTC proceedings. Call DAV or contact your local AMVETS chapter before your next court date.
Cohen Veterans Network — 1-855-204-5784 — mental health support and legal navigation for veterans in the justice system.
